footer: You're receiving this email about your account or order.

login_code.subject: Your sign-in code: {code}
login_code.body: Your sign-in code is {code}. It expires in 10 minutes. If you didn't request it, you can ignore this email.

supplier_invite.subject: You're invited to join {supplier} as a manufacturing partner
supplier_invite.body: Accept the invitation and set up your workshop: {link}

request_received.subject: We received your request {order}
request_received.body: Thanks! Our team will review your request and reply within one business day. Track it here: {link}

quote_ready.subject: Your quote for {order} is ready
quote_ready.body: Total {total}, valid until {expires}. Review and pay here: {link}

customer_message.subject: A new message about {order}
customer_message.body: Our team sent you a message: “{message}”. Reply here: {link}

payment_succeeded.subject: Payment received for {order}
payment_succeeded.body: Thanks! We've received {total} and are preparing production. Track your order: {link}

production_started.subject: Your part {order} is in production
production_started.body: Your part is being made now. We'll let you know once it passes our quality check. {link}

order_delayed.subject: An update on {order}
order_delayed.body: We're re-making your part to meet our quality standard. The new estimated ship date is {date}. Sorry for the wait. {link}

shipped.subject: {order} is on its way
shipped.body: Your part passed quality control and has shipped with {carrier}. Tracking number: {tracking}. {link}

delivered.subject: {order} was delivered
delivered.body: Your part has been delivered. If anything isn't right, tell us within 7 days: {link}

refund_completed.subject: Refund issued for {order}
refund_completed.body: We've refunded {amount}. It may take a few business days to appear on your statement.

qc_failed_supplier.subject: Quality check failed for job {job}
qc_failed_supplier.body: Reason: {reason}. A reprint is required. Details: {link}
